config.CBHCF_LAMBDA_PROVENANCE: cold_val, 2 seeds, mean NDCG@100 over k=[0, 2, 5, 10, 20] + within-item ceiling, subject to the warm-NDCG guard; field weights and lambda searched on the SAME grid for both arms so neither has a tuning advantage (notebooks/intervention_a_weight_sweep.ipynb, assembled by recsys.steel_config)
config.IB_USAGE: fold-in only; synthetic pairs never entered any fit()

population_sensitivity.merit_excluded_because: merit share is derived from the held-out set, i.e. from the eval users; dividing full-population exposure by it would mix populations (the D4 defect). ExposureAccumulator returns NaN merit stats for any run whose scored users are not exactly the merit users.

mode_b.intervention_b_ceiling_note: shares CBHCF's Mode B ceiling by construction: the synthetic wrapper overrides the reveal path only
